restored_predecessor_carry.rule: Carry this exact predecessor parent into b=2,d=148. Do not recompute parent BC16#0.

recovery_design.target_population: the same 69 generation3 target identities; schedule only the 68 missing targets plus b=3,d=148 because its frozen partial contains zero reusable completed mathematical subunits

modes.design: Do not repeat the generation2 flat16 artifact topology that exceeded the 900000-byte recovery-slot cap. Partition execution/evidence below the target before any heavy arm; persist independently verifiable bounded child certificates and aggregate only after exact coverage verification.

Use BC64 children grouped into exact BC16 parents. For b=2,d=148 inject the restored BC16#0 predecessor payload and schedule only parents 1..15. For all other d=148 targets schedule only missing exact children/parents; the b=3,d=148 cancelled partial contributes no completed subunit.

exactness: Every target retains the same mathematical worker/population semantics as audited BR204.
BC16 parent p equals the exact disjoint union of BC64 children p,p+16,p+32,p+48.
No target completion is credited until exact child/parent coverage is verified with no gaps or overlaps.
Artifact retrieval must be paginated or use a deterministic compact carry manifest when expected artifact count can reach 100.
durability: Upload only validated completed subunits on ordinary interruption/cancellation.
Keep each persisted recovery object below its audited cap; measure representative payload before scale-out.
Do not depend on the replacement Actions artifact surviving past its retention window without first consuming it into the next durable carry chain.

gates.next_required: Implement a cold resume-first G4 execution surface and verifier, source-lock this design and restored carry, measure storage/concurrency, freeze it, then obtain a distinct hostile audit before any arm.
